title: Select Customer Address dialog is empty for both Venue and Master launchers — 'Total Addresses: 0' because the page-load call GET /navigator/api/location/navigator-legacy/getLocationDetail returns HTTP 500
requirementSource: Account & Address sub-tab (/locations/1604/settings/location) > Venue card 'Address' button (data-testid location-settings-btn-venue-address) and Master card 'Address' button (data-testid location-settings-btn-master-address) each open the 'Select Customer Address' picker, whose table lists the customer's addresses so one can be checked and applied to the location. The dialog is a new-site feature and its populated behaviour was recorded on the new site in specs_planning/_internal/old-site-baseline/account-address-2026-06-11.md line 25: 'Master Bill To Address | static display (no picker affordance) — 4200 E Palm Canyon Dr | launcher -> "Select Customer Address" dialog (per-row checkbox select) -> updates Master dds; selection PERSISTS through save+reload'. The row count was frozen as ADDRESS_SEARCH.totalRows = 7 in src/data/locations/location-account-address.ts:23, and the selectable row '4200 E Palm Canyon Dr' is encoded in ALT_ADDRESS at the same file. So the dialog demonstrably listed addresses on the new site three months before this filing.
stepsToReproduce: Click the Venue card's 'Address' button (data-testid location-settings-btn-venue-address) to open the 'Select Customer Address' dialog.
Wait at least 8 seconds for the list to load (LR-ENC-008 loading-window allowance) and read the counter at the foot of the table.

Observe: the counter reads 'Total Addresses: 0'. The table renders its seven column headers (Address 1, Address 2, Address 3, City, State, Zip Code, Country) plus a single placeholder row whose cells are all blank, and the 'Select' and 'Save' buttons stay disabled because no row can be checked.
Click 'Cancel', then click the Master card's 'Address' button (data-testid location-settings-btn-master-address).
Observe: the same dialog again reads 'Total Addresses: 0'.

Open DevTools > Network (or capture responses) and filter to /navigator/api. Observe GET /navigator/api/location/navigator-legacy/getLocationDetail?localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US returned HTTP 500 during the initial page load, and that opening either dialog issues NO further address request — the dialog renders purely from that failed page-load payload.
expectedBehavior: Both the Venue and the Master 'Address' launchers open the 'Select Customer Address' dialog populated with the customer's address rows — 7 rows for office 1604, per the value frozen at src/data/locations/location-account-address.ts:23 and the dialog behaviour recorded in the 2026-06-11 account-address walk. Each row is selectable via its checkbox, which enables the 'Select' button, and the search box filters the rows client-side to a smaller non-zero set (e.g. 'Beverly' matches '8899 Beverly Blvd Ste 412').
actualBehavior: Both launchers open a dialog whose table contains no data rows and whose footer reads 'Total Addresses: 0'. A single placeholder row is rendered with every cell blank. 'Select' and 'Save' remain disabled because there is nothing to check, and the search box can only filter an already-empty set. The cause is server-side: the page-load request GET /navigator/api/location/navigator-legacy/getLocationDetail?localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US returns HTTP 500 with body {"success":false,"validationErrors":null,"message":"NavigatorAPI request failed (500)","statusCode":500}. Because the dialog issues no request of its own and renders from that page-load payload, the single failed call starves both the Venue and the Master picker. Note also that the request URL contains a malformed empty query parameter — 'localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US' has a doubled ampersand — which is worth checking as a possible trigger, though it has not been proven to be the cause.
rootCauseLayer: SERVER-SIDE (app backend). The browser issues a well-formed GET to the navigator-legacy getLocationDetail endpoint and the API answers HTTP 500 with a generic 'NavigatorAPI request failed (500)' envelope, indicating the Navigator legacy service behind the BFF is erroring or unreachable. This is NOT a front-end defect and NOT a test defect: the nine affected tests correctly expect the addresses the endpoint is contracted to supply. A secondary front-end robustness concern is that the dialog degrades silently — a failed upstream call surfaces to the user as a legitimate-looking empty list ('Total Addresses: 0') rather than an error state, so a user cannot tell 'this customer has no addresses' from 'the server failed'. The malformed doubled ampersand in the query string is a front-end URL-construction smell that should be ruled in or out as the 500's trigger.

mcpEvidence.tool: mcp__playwright-test__* browser tools driving live cloudapps-e2e in the encore-locations project, using the shared authenticated storageState at .auth/encore-state.json (user s-prd-clickauto@psav.com).
mcpEvidence.findings: Live replication against cloudapps-e2e on 2026-09-22 (office 1604). Navigated to /navigator/locations/1604/settings/location and opened the Account and Address sub-tab. Clicked the Venue 'Address' launcher; the dialog opened correctly (heading 'Select Customer Address', search box, full seven-column header row, Save/Select/Cancel/Close controls all present) so this is not a dialog-rendering failure. Waited 8 seconds before reading the table, per LR-ENC-008, to rule out a loading window. The accessibility snapshot showed exactly one tbody row, with all cells empty, and the footer text 'Total Addresses: 0'. Cancelled, then clicked the Master 'Address' launcher: the footer again read 'Total Addresses: 0'. Network capture filtered to /navigator/api showed GET /navigator/api/location/navigator-legacy/getLocationDetail?localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US -> HTTP 500, response body verbatim {"success":false,"validationErrors":null,"message":"NavigatorAPI request failed (500)","statusCode":500}. Re-filtering the network log after opening the dialogs returned that same single entry and nothing else, proving the dialog makes no address request of its own and depends entirely on the failed page-load payload. Every other /navigator/api call on the page returned HTTP 200, so this is one specific endpoint failing rather than a broad outage or an auth problem.
mcpEvidence.anomaly: The failure is silent at the UI layer: a 500 from the upstream service is presented to the user as a well-formed empty list with a '0' counter, not as an error. Separately, the request URL carries a doubled ampersand ('...localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US'), i.e. an empty query parameter between the two real ones.

networkEvidence: Endpoint: GET https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/api/location/navigator-legacy/getLocationDetail?localOfficeId=1604&&culture=en-US. Observed response: HTTP 500, body {"success":false,"validationErrors":null,"message":"NavigatorAPI request failed (500)","statusCode":500}. Fired once during page load of /navigator/locations/1604/settings/location. Opening either the Venue or the Master address launcher issues no additional network request — confirmed by re-querying the captured network log filtered on 'navigator-legacy|getLocation|address' after both dialogs had been opened, which returned only this one entry. All sibling calls on the same page (api/location/1604, api/core/countries, api/location/country-list, api/location/state-list, api/core/sctc, etc.) returned HTTP 200, isolating the failure to this single endpoint.
baselineEvidence: specs_planning/_internal/old-site-baseline/account-address-2026-05-29.md line 57 records the 'Select Customer Address' picker dialog (venue + master bill-to) as 'absent — old site exposes addresses via separate Pay To Address' — the old site offers no equivalent picker, so there is no baseline behaviour to adjudicate this against and the LR-034 enum value is baseline-absent rather than regression-from-baseline. The regression is nevertheless real against the NEW site's own recorded behaviour: specs_planning/_internal/old-site-baseline/account-address-2026-06-11.md line 25 documents the new-site dialog as a working 'launcher -> Select Customer Address dialog (per-row checkbox select) -> updates Master dds; selection PERSISTS through save+reload', and src/data/locations/location-account-address.ts:23 froze the observed row count at totalRows = 7. Both were captured while the dialog listed addresses; it now lists none.

testImpactNote: All nine failures in tests/locations/location-account-address.spec.ts trace to this single defect; they are not nine independent problems. They were first observed in TestRail run 2218 (the 2026-09-22 full regression at 9 workers) and were then re-driven at --workers=1 in the isolation run 'MFE-E2E-Regression-Testing — 2026-09-22 20:53 (local-isolation)', where all nine reproduced — so contention is excluded as an explanation. The three distinct error signatures are all downstream of the empty table: an exact-count assertion (expected 7, received 0), relative-count assertions (toBeLessThan / toBeGreaterThan against an initial value that is itself 0), and click timeouts waiting for locator('[role="dialog"]:has-text("Select Customer Address") table').locator('tbody tr:has-text("4200 E Palm Canyon Dr")'), which cannot resolve in an empty tbody. The tests must NOT be relaxed or re-baselined to accept 0 rows — that would delete a real finding. They should stay failing until the endpoint is fixed, or be marked blocked with a reference to this bug, consistent with the nine test.fixme entries already in this spec that point at the sibling defect BUG-LOC-ACC-002.
